# Passport renewed

The renewal forms went in by post at the start of the month, with photos taken at the local
pharmacy. The first photo was rejected for a shadow behind the head, so a second set was taken
against a plain white door, which passed.

The new passports arrived three weeks later, a week sooner than the office had estimated. The old
passports came back separately, with their corners clipped, two days after that.

Lesson for next time: take the photos in daylight against a white wall, and send everything in one
envelope with tracking so there is a record of the date it was posted.
